audit.reasoning: The record codes Domari as fixed-dominant final stress on the strength of a single Wikipedia sentence (tertiary, paraphrasing Matras 1999); no source file was held and cite/loc/grade fields are empty. I verified the Wikipedia sentence verbatim in the live wikitext, then fetched sources two open primary descriptions: Matras's ELL2 'Domari' entry (p. 2: 'Stress normally falls on the final inflectional segment of the word. sources.citation: Wikipedia, Domari language, Stress section (re-read 2026-08-31; cites Matras 1999)
sources.quote: The Domari language emphasizes stress on the final syllable, as well as grammatical markers for gender and number.

sources.citation: Herin, Bruno. 2012. The Domari Language of Aleppo (Syria). Linguistic Discovery 10(2): 1-52. doi:10.1349/PS1.1537-0852.A.412
sources.quote: "Judging by the recorded data, stress assignment in Aleppo Domari is the same as in Palestinian Domari: it falls on the last syllable of the phonological word ... Stress on the first syllable was recorded in certain adverbs of time ... only Layer I case markers ... and bound pronouns are part of the domain of stress ... Layer II markers are never stressed ... Items borrowed from Arabic are integrated into the Domari stress pattern." (cites Matras 1999:14 for Palestinian Domari)
sources.note: Open-access primary fieldwork description with an explicit section 1.3 'Stress' (p. 8): final stress on the phonological word, Layer II case markers and plural /n/ outside the stress domain, initial stress in a few time adverbs and under perfective negation n-. fetched sources now; confirms coding and supplies domain detail for the empty 'domain' field (Northern/Aleppo variety).
